selection.edition: international Better Stack Uptime and Telemetry APIs
selection.ownership: Better Stack (Delaware corporation with headquarters in Prague, Czech Republic, and San Francisco). The reviewed edition is the international Uptime API at uptime.betterstack.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Better Stack Uptime API Bearer tokens, GET /api/v3/incidents, GET /api/v3/incidents/{id}, GET /api/v2/incidents/{id}/comments, metadata list, Prague/San Francisco identity, and dated incident search for Better Stack / Better Uptime security breach reviewed on 2026-09-13. BrowserStack inbox-spam reporting is a distinct company. Logs/telemetry hosts are a different edition. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official Uptime API at uptime.betterstack.com plus Telemetry source-groups at telemetry.betterstack.com. Composio BETTER_STACK 117-tool catalog mapped to documented REST routes. GET_UPTIME_API_TOKEN is not an HTTP API.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Better Stack / Better Uptime security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-credential compromise. BrowserStack email-spam reporting is a distinct company.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

domain_expiration.description: Advance warning in days before domain expiration. Allowed values: 1, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30, or 60.

playwright_script.description: JavaScript code for playwright monitor type. Defines browser automation scenario to execute during checks.

pronounceable_name.description: Human-readable name for the monitor displayed in the dashboard.

confirmation_period.description: How long in seconds to observe failures before creating an incident. Helps avoid false alerts from transient issues.

expiration_policy_id.description: ID of the escalation policy for SSL certificate and domain expiration alerts. Null sends email to team.

maintenance_timezone.description: Timezone for maintenance window times. Use Rails TimeZone values. Defaults to UTC.

environment_variables.description: Key-value pairs of environment variables accessible within playwright scripts. Useful for parameterizing automation scenarios.

expected_status_codes.description: Array of acceptable HTTP status codes for successful checks. Used with expected_status_code monitor type.

name.description: Display name for the monitor group visible in the dashboard.

paused.description: Set to true to pause monitoring for any existing monitors in the group; false to resume monitoring.

sort_index.description: Numeric value controlling monitor group sort order in the dashboard.

monitor_group_id.description: The ID of the monitor group to update. Use list monitor groups to find available IDs.

name.description: The name of the schedule

schedule_id.description: The ID of the on-call schedule you want to update

name.description: Integration display name

outgoing_webhook_id.description: The ID of the Outgoing Webhook integration you want to update

custom_webhook_template_attributes.description: Custom webhook template attributes such as HTTP method, headers, and body.

name.description: New name for the escalation policy group visible in the dashboard.

sort_index.description: Zero-based index to control the display order of escalation policy groups in the dashboard.

policy_group_id.description: The ID of the escalation policy group to update. Use list policy groups to find available IDs.

name.description: The new display name of the source group

sort_index.description: Order index to control group sorting. Must be non-negative.

source_group_id.description: The ID of the source group you want to update

name.description: A descriptive label for the group visible in the dashboard.

sort_index.description: Numeric value determining the group's display order.

status_page_group_id.description: The ID of the status page group to update. Use list status page groups to find available IDs.

title.description: The updated title/name for the status page report

ends_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the report concludes. Required for maintenance-type reports.

report_id.description: The numeric ID of the status report to update (e.g., '824282').

starts_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the report becomes active. Defaults to current time if not provided.

status_page_id.description: The numeric ID of the status page (e.g., '221582'). Obtain this from the list_status_pages action.

affected_resources.description: List of status page resources affected by this report, with their status. Each object must contain status_page_resource_id and status fields.

position.description: Zero-indexed placement; unspecified defaults to end position

explanation.description: Helper text displayed as an icon

public_name.description: How the resource appears on your public status page

fixed_position.description: Boolean preventing position reordering when enabled

status_page_id.description: The identifier of your status page

status_page_section_id.description: Section assignment (defaults to first section if omitted)

history.description: Number of days to display on the status page. Between 7 and 365 days

logo_url.description: URL of the logo image. Image should be under 20MB

password.description: Password for accessing the status page (when password_enabled is true)

subdomain.description: Subdomain for the status page. Must be globally unique

custom_css.description: Custom CSS to apply to the status page

contact_url.description: URL for contact or support page

announcement.description: Announcement text to display on the status page

company_name.description: Company name shown on the status page

ip_allowlist.description: List of IP addresses allowed to access the page

subscribable.description: Whether visitors can subscribe for updates

custom_domain.description: Custom domain for the status page

status_page_id.description: Identifier for the status page being modified

navigation_links.description: Custom navigation links for the status page

password_enabled.description: Whether a password is required to view the page

custom_javascript.description: Custom JavaScript to apply to the status page

min_incident_length.description: Minimum incident duration in seconds to be displayed

status_page_group_id.description: ID of the status page group to assign this page to

hide_from_search_engines.description: Whether the page should be hidden from search engines

name.description: Section title. Omit to hide the header.

position.description: Zero-indexed placement on the status page. Unspecified adds to end.

section_id.description: The section identifier you want to modify.

status_page_id.description: The identifier for your status page.

message.description: Message associated with the status update, providing details about the current state or actions taken.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for publication time. If not provided, uses the original published time.

status_page_id.description: Your status page identifier. Obtain from list_status_pages action.

status_report_id.description: Your status page report identifier. Obtain from list_status_page_reports action.

status_update_id.description: Your status update identifier. Obtain from list_status_page_report_status_updates action.

affected_resources.description: Array of affected resources with their current status. If provided, must contain at least one resource.

notify_subscribers.description: Send notification email to subscribers. Default is false.

sms.description: Enables SMS notifications for new incidents at this severity level

call.description: Enables phone calls for new incidents at this severity level

name.description: The identifier for this severity level

push.description: Enables push notifications for new incidents at this severity level

email.description: Enables email notifications for new incidents at this severity level

urgency_id.description: The ID of the severity level to update

name.description: The display name for the group visible in the dashboard.

sort_index.description: Determines the sorting order of the severity group. Must be non-negative.

urgency_group_id.description: The ID of the urgency group (severity group) to update. You can get this from the list urgency groups action.
